item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Justice Dept. admits Reflecting Pool renovation was flawed, drops case against former Olympian
item.description: The Justice Department is admitting that $14 million renovation on the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in Washington, DC, was flawed, and is dropping its case against a former Olympian.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Over 100 women's college basketball players team up in unionization effort
item.description: More than 100 women's college basketball players have teamed up to form a union for college athletes as part of their growing push to collectively bargain with their schools.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Duke Energy franchise agreement with city of St. Pete expires
item.description: The city of St. Pete’s franchise agreement with Duke Energy expires on Friday, but local leaders said service will not be interrupted.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New Port Richey nonprofit proposes turning vacant downtown building into STEAM discovery center
item.description: A vacant city-owned building in downtown New Port Richey could become home to a hands-on science discovery center for children if a local nonprofit's vision becomes reality.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa rescue team: Firefighters recognized for Venezuela earthquake response
item.description: Three Tampa Fire Rescue firefighters were honored Friday after risking their lives in Venezuela to search through rubble and rescue survivors following two major June earthquakes.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Family of Gandy Blvd. murder victim pleaded with gov. to sign death warrant
item.description: Nearly forty years after a man was sentenced to death for a killing along Gandy Blvd., daughters of the victim are begging the governor to finally sign a death warrant.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Petersburg crosswalk upgrades: City improves school zone safety
item.description: St. Petersburg officials are upgrading crosswalks near St. Pete High School after a student was hit by a car and critically injured in May.
